blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers including Lagers, IPAs, Stouts, and more, paired with a full-service kitchen menu featuring sourdough pizzas, chicken wings, salads, burgers, and desserts. The brewery is set in a former movie theater with a nostalgic atmosphere, offering events like movie nights, trivia, and live music. Private events and outdoor dining are available, with a dog-friendly patio during warmer months.
